text: SELECT molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, drug_indication.efo_id, drug_indication.efo_term, drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind FROM molecule_dictionary, drug_indication, compound_structures WHERE molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno AND molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno AND drug_indication.mesh_heading LIKE '%lung%'
